no_undocumented_inference: No natal claim can be promoted from pure astronomical table, source commentary on different class of divination, or attractive posthoc life story.
update_rules: When source first-read becomes accepted, change same family state + original ref and update overview.
When a testable claim is extracted, assign claim ID and map precisely one chart predicate to at least one observable with predeclared contrary cases.
When human study starts, freeze model and cohort metadata before any response; maintain separate Human Design, natal, timing, electional, relationship denominators.
When a linked source is merely derivative of another, preserve dependency and never count corroboration as independent.
